test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
From the given options, select the letter that is different from the other three on the basis of the letter clusters given below:

ABCDE FGHIJ KLMNO PQRST UVWXY
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

1) Y → Letter Y is the fifth letter of given word group UVWXY.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d3514efb4bffe7469ba4d0f8cc6a98dd0600838375634b0fcb97ddc71e3f5d9.png] 

2) W → Letter W is the third letter of given word group UVWXY.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1f5494518639556fe4367a98d34f72207a68974dd6990434431e76342b2ceb3.png] 

3) M → letter M is the third letter of given word group KLMNO.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b31851c2e764cea2dbb49348b5c8e3f90a689f8cd5adb2d25b7f34c6bcdde3d.png] 

4) H → H is the third letter of given word group FGHIJ.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf98a6219b1aef1be5a4c415909c6a4950fb0f5c7a5b32ce719f71764e7b9147.png] 

∴ Here, position of 'Y' is different from other three alternatives.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Y".**
